purpose: A reduced-n five-language screen of whether Qwen3.5-0.8B retains credible relative competence in Spanish, French, and Russian, with Qwen2.5-1.5B, Qwen3-0.6B, and Falcon-H1-1.5B controls.
scope_warning: This is a HOST screen at n=120 items per language, not the parent plan's n>=1200 non-inferiority study and not a native-speaker validation. It can detect collapse and rank the four frozen arms; it cannot certify native fluency.

models.thinking_mode: disabled at template render with enable_thinking=false
not exposed by this chat template; no reasoning prompt is added

models.role: footprint floor and Stack H control
models.thinking_mode: disabled at template render with enable_thinking=false
not exposed by this chat template; no reasoning prompt is added

harness.model_loading: One GGUF arm at a time; no conversion, quantization, export, fine-tuning, or training.
harness.prompt_rendering: Pinned Hugging Face tokenizer chat template rendered to UTF-8, then supplied as a raw prompt to llama.cpp. The rendered prompt SHA-256 for the first item of every language/model is retained.
harness.cache_prompt_reason: The pinned llama.cpp server documentation warns that prompt-cache reuse can change logits with different batch shapes.

global_mmlu.selection: 54 CA and 26 CS items, category-stratified, time-sensitive annotations excluded, stable SHA-256 ordering

native_generation.authorship: Codex-authored directly in each target language before candidate output existed; no native-human authorship or validation claimed.

system_by_language.en: Answer directly in English. Do not show reasoning. Keep the answer concise and suitable for speech.
system_by_language.zh: 请只用简体中文直接作答，不要展示推理过程。回答要简洁，适合语音播报。
system_by_language.es: Responde directamente en español. No muestres el razonamiento. Sé conciso y apto para voz.
system_by_language.fr: Répondez directement en français. Ne montrez pas votre raisonnement. Soyez concis et adapté à l'oral.
system_by_language.ru: Отвечайте прямо по-русски. Не показывайте ход рассуждений. Ответ должен быть кратким и пригодным для озвучивания.

mcq_instruction_by_language.en: Return only the letter A, B, C, or D.
mcq_instruction_by_language.zh: 只返回字母 A、B、C 或 D。
mcq_instruction_by_language.es: Devuelve solo la letra A, B, C o D.
mcq_instruction_by_language.fr: Répondez uniquement par la lettre A, B, C ou D.
mcq_instruction_by_language.ru: Верните только букву A, B, C или D.

prompts.thinking_assertion: For qwen35_08b and qwen3_06b, apply_chat_template(..., add_generation_prompt=true, enable_thinking=false) is mandatory. Prompting the model not to think is not a substitute. Any other template setting is a protocol deviation.
prompts.mode_pin_violation_rule: A rendered Qwen prompt lacking the template's non-thinking empty-think block, or any output reasoning tag/initial deliberation match, is recorded. A model arm with >0.5% template/mode-pin violations is VOID for ranking.

global_mmlu.scoring_path: Length-normalized log-likelihood of each answer-letter continuation; select the maximum. No generated rationale and no judge.

native_generation.raw_output_policy: Retain the exact UTF-8 completion before normalization or filtering.

scoring.global_mmlu_correctness: C_i=1 when the highest length-normalized log-likelihood answer letter equals the frozen gold letter; otherwise 0.
scoring.native_generation_correctness: C_i is binary from the item's frozen deterministic regex/structure rubric. Reference answers are audit examples only; no semantic judge may rescue a frozen rubric failure.

surface_fluency_proxy.warning: This is a mechanical surface proxy for language/script/degeneracy/speakability, not native fluency, grammaticality, or cultural appropriateness.
surface_fluency_proxy.language_component_L: With >=8 Unicode letters, restrict Lingua to EN/ES/FR/RU/ZH: L=1 if expected language is top, L=0.5 if expected confidence is within 0.10 of the maximum, else 0. With <8 letters, L=S.
surface_fluency_proxy.script_component_S: EN/ES/FR: Latin ratio >=0.90. RU: Cyrillic ratio >=0.90. ZH: Han/(Han+Latin+Cyrillic) >=0.70 and OpenCC t2s changes no Han-bearing segment. No-script numeric/symbol answers get S=1 only if their correctness rubric passes.
surface_fluency_proxy.nondegenerate_component_D: Nonempty; no U+FFFD; no disallowed C0/C1 controls; no letter/digit repeated six times consecutively; no same word repeated four times consecutively.
surface_fluency_proxy.speakability_component_P: No URL, backtick, Markdown heading, table pipe, emoji, bare LaTeX delimiter, list longer than three entries, or reasoning-leakage match.

concision.latin_cyrillic_languages: K_i=1 iff nonempty and <=60 words, using Unicode letter/mark words plus numeric tokens; otherwise 0.
concision.zh: K_i=1 iff nonempty and <=90 non-whitespace NFKC code points; otherwise 0.

scoring.language_score: score_lang = 100 * sum(s_i over the 120 frozen items) / 120, using unrounded values internally
scoring.strict_generation_pass: Also report the unweighted rate where C_i=1, F_i=1, and K_i=1; it does not replace the headline score.
scoring.intervals: Report Wilson 95% intervals for binary component rates. Report a 10,000-resample item bootstrap 95% interval for score_lang with RNG seed 20260801. Intervals are diagnostic at this reduced n and do not change the mechanical point-estimate rule.

failure_mode_counters.denominator: Exactly 40 native generations per language and 200 per model. Per-language rates therefore have n=40; the >=200 requirement is met per model across the five frozen languages, not per model-language. This reduced sprint interpretation is disclosed and is weaker than the parent plan.
failure_mode_counters.wrong_language: For outputs with >=8 Unicode letters, wrong_language=1 when expected Lingua confidence is >0.20 below the maximum and the maximum is >=0.70. Report eligible n and do not turn ineligible short numeric answers into language evidence.
failure_mode_counters.wrong_script_en_es_fr: wrong_script=1 with >=4 script-assigned letters and Latin ratio <0.90.
failure_mode_counters.wrong_script_ru: wrong_script=1 with >=4 script-assigned letters and Cyrillic ratio <0.90; retain the raw ratio.
failure_mode_counters.wrong_script_zh: wrong_script=1 with >=4 Han+Latin+Cyrillic characters and Han ratio <0.70.
failure_mode_counters.traditional_han_leakage: On raw ZH output before B2 normalization, leakage=1 if OpenCC t2s changes any Han-bearing segment; report changed-Han fraction and response count.

reasoning_leakage.inspection: Raw output after NFKC only; case-insensitive. Tags match anywhere. Step/deliberation preambles match only when beginning within the first 40 Unicode code points.
first_40_regex: (?:让我想想|我们需要(?:分析|推理)|我需要(?:分析|推理)|思考过程|推理过程)
reasoning_leakage.interpretation: A reproducible lower bound; marker-free prose reasoning can be missed.

decision_rule.competence_ratio: ratio_lang = score_lang / score_en for the same model, from unrounded values. score_en=0 makes the arm UNDECIDABLE.

qwen35_outcomes.condition: es, fr, and ru ratios are all >=0.75
ru alone is <0.75 and es/fr are >=0.75
es or fr is <0.75, or two or more of es/fr/ru are <0.75

decision_rule.single_es_or_fr_gap_resolution: The lane text explicitly grants a reduced-scope exception only to RU and otherwise omits the one-failure ES/FR branch. Frozen conservative resolution before seeing outputs: any ES-only or FR-only failure moves to Q/F.
decision_rule.q_vs_f_leader: Compare unrounded language scores directly. The arm winning more of the five languages leads. If language-win counts tie, choose the arm with the higher minimum of its own es/en, fr/en, and ru/en ratios; then higher RU score; then Qwen2.5-1.5B as the incumbent/headroom tie-break. No cross-language average may rescue a language.

prior_registered_before_run.interpretation: Directional but statistically weak; the prior is context, never substituted for this screen.
prior_registered_before_run.quantization_confound: The prior challenger was recorded only as Q4 while the incumbent was Q4_K_M. The present screen uses each frozen shipping artifact and names the format difference rather than treating it as controlled.

evidence_rules.scores: HOST only after an actual Colab execution with raw outputs, environment, hashes, seed, and n retained. VENDOR or BENCHMARK values may not substitute.
evidence_rules.artifact_revisions_and_lfs_hashes: EXACT from repository metadata before download; downloaded bytes must match before execution.
evidence_rules.unknown_policy: A model/runtime failure is reported as UNKNOWN or documented remote-run failure. It is never filled from a vendor table or another language.

deviation_policy: Any change to model/revision/file hash, item or order, prompt, template setting, decoding parameter, rubric, detector, weight, threshold, or leader tie-break after this hash requires an append-only deviation record with timestamp and reason. The frozen result is not silently replaced.
